Luke, I’ll commit to 15 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree. I’d also like us to agree now on the low-stock contingency: if next month starts at 50 tons, we each take no more than 5. That leaves 25 tons and keeps the fishery viable, though it still doesn’t guarantee a return to 100.

After catches are revealed, let’s check both the stock and whether everyone honored the agreement before setting the next quotas. I won’t support simply repeating 15 each regardless of what remains.

Kate, are you willing to agree to 15 this month and the 5-ton limit if next month starts at 50?
